prompt: Which of the following Sieve conditions checks if the incoming email is from "admin@example.com" and has been sent to more than 5 recipients?
explanation: The relational comparator `address :count "gt" :all "to" "5"` (RFC 5231) is true when the message was sent to more than 5 recipients; with the from-address check it matches mail from admin@example.com to over 5 recipients.
